title: Long-Term Passive Revenue Readiness

revenue_readiness: First-party ad containers are present but hidden while ads are inactive.

Ad placement avoids active citation workflow controls and citation explanations.

Guide content does not depend on ad scripts.
Ad blockers or ad network outages must not break site navigation or citation generation.
No external analytics or advertising requests are made in this EP.
